cities.comment: Play the Globe Arena. Dance style music is what really attract the big crowds to this venue.

cities.comment: Unless you're into musicals, dance music is the dish of the day in this metropole.
cities.name: London

cities.comment: The Muscovites like both kinds: heavy AND metal.
cities.name: Moscow

cities.comment: Metal bands go to Japan when their careers dry out elsewhere. Punkrockers might wanna give it a try too.
cities.name: Tokyo

cities.name: Cape Town

cities.name: Berlin

cities.comment: Nothing is as big with Czechs as metal. The heavier the better.
cities.name: Prague

cities.comment: Maple leafs aside, rock is the order of the day in this beautiful city.

cities.comment: These Canadians are really into soda. And pop.

cities.comment: If it ain't metal, it ain't worth the plastic its pressed on.

cities.comment: Pop goes the weasle. Get the picture?
cities.name: Cairo

cities.name: New Delhi

cities.comment: Once the Gibraltar of Asia, Hong Kong has its own rock. Except theirs is musical rather than mineral.

cities.name: Beijing
